notes.title: Version [1.0.0.133.0] - 2024-04-11
notes.notes:
• Tricks: Fixed multi barspins and whips / whoppers will track properly for stat counter
• Achievements: Fixed Fixed issues with achievements popping on start up. 
• Achievements: Added Cheat code on quick menu to reset achievements. Down Up Down Up Down Up Left Left Left Right
• Settings: Added Slow motion FX toggle to toggle the visual effect during slow motion
• Settings: Changed Slow motion setting has 3 modes now. Off / Timer / Toggle
• Audio: Changed Reduced Drift Trike volume

notes.title: Version [1.0.0.121.0] - 2024-04-09
notes.notes:
• Challenge Gameplay: Fixed Repeating challenge tiers will no longer show the reward screen again.
• Physics: Changed Pumping only requires left stick now
• Physics: Added Pumping for mannys and noseys
• Physics: Added Max lean setting in gameplay settings tab
• Physics: Added Improved bonkability. When bonking something the character should not "freeze" for a few frames.

notes.title: Version [1.0.0.117.0] - 2024-04-08
notes.notes:
• Physics: Changed Flip input with the stick is less sensitive to prevent accidental flips
• BMX: Fixed your bike should load in correct on start up
• Challenge Gameplay: Fixed Entering a challenge from pause menu will activate the challenge properly
• BMX: Fixed Rasta chain and oil slick stem bolts

notes.title: Version [1.0.0.116.0]
notes.notes:
• Physics: Changed Reduced physics based steer wobble when sprinting by 50%
• Gameplay: Changed Time to stand up from ragdoll made faster
• Physics: Changed increased min time needed in air for assisters to kick in. Overall, reduces jank levels when bumping around on rails ect.

notes.title: Version [1.0.0.111.0] - 2024-04-07
notes.notes:
• Settings: Fixed mutli monitor set ups will prefer the main display
• Physics: Changed Wheels have zero clip physics now. Improving grind collision and collisions in general. This also improves manuals and noseys. This creates a bit stiffer impression though when rolling up or down stairs for now untill future physics works. 
• Physics: Changed removed bail triggers on handle bars.
